clauses.quote: Representatives of the WTU and DCPS shall conduct the trainings.
clauses.subject_text: Representatives of the WTU and DCPS
clauses.notes: Joint duty between union and district representatives.

clauses.quote: The DCPS representatives may include individuals from the Office of the Chancellor, the Office of the General Counsel, Labor Management Employee Relations, and the Office of Human Resources.
DCPS shall provide written notice of potential school reform, inclusive of all options under NCLB for restructuring, to the WTU and all Teachers in the affected schools that have been identified.
These Teachers shall receive, at a minimum, the salaries and benefits provided by this Agreement.
Assignment to a Partnership School shall be voluntary.
clauses.notes: Impersonal construction granting transfer choice to teachers.

clauses.quote: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools may be required to work a longer day and a longer year than is required under this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools
clauses.notes: Passive construction granting management discretion to impose extended hours.

clauses.quote: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools may be required to undertake job responsibilities and to participate in staff meetings and other activities beyond the requirements of this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools

clauses.quote: In advance of accepting assignment to a Partnership School, Teachers shall receive, for each School, information detailing any differences, if any, in the working conditions at the Partnership Schools
clauses.notes: Truncated at end of chunk but complete clause.
